import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final boolean DEBUG = false;
    static final long INFFLUJO = 100000000000000L;
    static final double INFCOSTO = 1e14;
    static final int MAXN = 50 * 100 + 15;
    static final int SRC = MAXN - 1;
    static final int SNC = MAXN - 2;

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int u, v;
            long cap, flow;
            double cost;
            long rem() { return cap - flow; }
            Edge(int u, int v, long cap, long flow, double cost) {
                this.u = u; this.v = v; this.cap = cap; this.flow = flow; this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        int n;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> g;
        ArrayList<Edge> e;
        double[] dist;
        int[] pre;
        long[] cap;
        boolean[] inq;
        long mxflow;
        double mncost;

        MinCostMaxFlow(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            e = new ArrayList<>();
            dist = new double[n];
            pre = new int[n];
            cap = new long[n];
            inq = new boolean[n];
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v, long cap, double cost) {
            if (DEBUG) {
                String dem = Integer.toString(u), pen = Integer.toString(v);
                if (u == SRC) dem = "SRC";
                if (u == SNC) dem = "SINC";
                if (v == SRC) pen = "SRC";
                if (v == SNC) pen = "SINC";
                System.out.println("add edge: " + dem + " " + pen + " " + cap + " " + cost);
            }
            g.get(u).add(e.size());
            e.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
            g.get(v).add(e.size());
            e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
        }

        void flow(int s, int t) {
            mxflow = 0;
            mncost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, INFCOSTO);
                dist[s] = 0;
                Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
                pre[s] = 0;
                Arrays.fill(cap, 0);
                cap[s] = INFFLUJO;
                Arrays.fill(inq, false);
                Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.add(s);
                inq[s] = true;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = q.poll();
                    inq[u] = false;
                    for (int idx : g.get(u)) {
                        Edge E = e.get(idx);
                        if (E.rem() > 0 && dist[E.v] > dist[u] + E.cost + 1e-9) {
                            dist[E.v] = dist[u] + E.cost;
                            pre[E.v] = idx;
                            cap[E.v] = Math.min(cap[u], E.rem());
                            if (!inq[E.v]) {
                                q.add(E.v);
                                inq[E.v] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (pre[t] < 0) break;
                mxflow += cap[t];
                mncost += cap[t] * dist[t];
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = e.get(pre[v]).u) {
                    e.get(pre[v]).flow += cap[t];
                    e.get(pre[v] ^ 1).flow -= cap[t];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        long c = sc.nextLong();
        long d = sc.nextLong();
        int MAXT = (int)(n + k);
        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("MAXT: " + MAXT);
        MinCostMaxFlow mcmf = new MinCostMaxFlow(MAXN);
        long[] a = new long[(int)k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextLong() - 1;
            mcmf.add_edge(SRC, (int)(a[i] * MAXT), 1, 0);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < MAXT; j++) {
            mcmf.add_edge(j, SNC, k, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    mcmf.add_edge(x * MAXT + j, y * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * K - 1));
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    mcmf.add_edge(y * MAXT + j, x * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * K - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    mcmf.add_edge(i * MAXT + j, i * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c);
                }
            }
        }
        mcmf.flow(SRC, SNC);
        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("mncost: " + mcmf.mncost + " mxflow: " + mcmf.mxflow);
        System.out.println((long)Math.round(mcmf.mncost));
    }
}
